capabilities: schedule AI tasks on cron, interval, one-shot, event or chained triggers
run tasks through installed backend plugins (Claudian, Oh My Claudian, Copilot)
write results as new, replaced, appended or daily-note output with fill-in variables
queue proposed edits to existing notes for approval as diffs
export upcoming runs as an .ics file or to Google and Outlook calendars
disambiguation: Does not call AI providers itself; it only plans, schedules and dispatches tasks through an already-installed backend plugin.
extras: Relies on non-public parts of the backend plugins, so backend updates can break task execution; calendar add-ons are marked beta; Claudian and Oh My Claudian work on desktop only, so scheduled tasks run on the computer, while Copilot also supports manual runs on mobile.
intentEvidence: It drives Claudian, Oh My Claudian or Copilot — whichever you have configured — and owns only the scheduling and execution layer.
problem: Obsidian AI plugins only run when you open a chat manually, so recurring AI work like reviews or summaries has to be triggered by hand each time.
